```{r}
### Functions 

source('/Users/dalvinikita/Desktop/macpie/R/filter_genes_by_expression.R')

create_dt <- function(x){
  DT::datatable(x,
                extensions = 'Buttons',
                options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                               buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                               lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                 c(10,25,50,"All"))))
}

plotRLE <- function(data, main = "", ylab = "Relative Log Expression") {
  # Calculate medians
  col <- brewer.pal(8, 'Set3')
  medians <- apply(data, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
  rle_data <- data - medians
  
  boxplot(as.data.frame(rle_data),
          outline = FALSE,
          las = 2,
          ylab = ylab,
          main = main,
          col = col)
  abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
}

red_blue_palette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(100)
```

```{r}
### Venn Diagram df

x <- list(`ncPACvsDMSO_p2`=p2_ncpac$X,
          `ncPACvsDMSO_p3`=p3_ncpac$X)

x.table <- venn(x[c("ncPACvsDMSO_p2","ncPACvsDMSO_p3")], show.plot = FALSE)
x_attributes <- attributes(x.table)

ggvenn(x, columns = c('ncPACvsDMSO_p2','ncPACvsDMSO_p3'), 
       show_percentage = FALSE,
       text_size = 8)

p2_genes <- x_attributes$intersections$ncPACvsDMSO_p2
p2_genes[1:25]

p3_genes <- x_attributes$intersections$ncPACvsDMSO_p3
p3_genes[1:25]
```
